generic.Defined scope/population: Beneficiary change requests awaiting compliance assessment against the contract beneficiary provision
generic.In-scope period: Requests sitting in the pending-assessment queue for the current servicing day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Designation type, allocation splits, trust name, trust date, trustee and cited contract provision all present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of assessed requests equals the count pulled from the pending-assessment queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment note and the contract form image version stored on the service request with a timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blocked or defective designations pended with a specific reason code and owner notification
generic.Test population: Sample of assessed beneficiary change requests spanning individual, trust and estate designations
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the assessment note omits the cited contract provision or the permitted or blocked outcome
generic.Exception handling path: Irrevocable-beneficiary blocks and trust defects pend to the Policy Administration Analyst for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Designation type is permitted by the contract form and allocation splits total exactly 100 percent
generic.Evidence location: Service request notes in the policy administration system plus the form image in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Retrieve the contract form image from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Open the policy in the policy administration system and note the product form number and state of issue
Search OpenText Document Mgmt for the issued contract image matching that form number
Confirm the image is the issued contract and not a specimen or marketing version
Done when the correct contract form image is open alongside the service request
verify: Check the form number on the image against the form number on the policy record
Pass when the opened image is the issued contract for this policy and state

steps.title: Read the Beneficiary provision and confirm the requested designation type is permitted
sop: Locate the Beneficiary provision in the contract image and read it in full
Compare the requested type (primary, contingent, irrevocable, trust, estate) against what the provision allows
Note the provision paragraph reference for citation in the assessment
Done when the requested designation type is classified permitted or blocked with a provision reference
verify: Re-read the provision reference and confirm it supports the classification recorded
Pass when the permitted or blocked call is traceable to a named contract paragraph

steps.title: Check the admin system for irrevocable beneficiary or collateral assignment blocks
sop: Open the beneficiary and assignment panels in the policy administration system
Flag any irrevocable beneficiary that removes the owner's unilateral right to change
Flag any recorded collateral or absolute assignment that constrains the designation
Done when every blocking interest on the policy is listed on the service request
verify: Cross-check the assignment register entry against the imaged assignment form
Pass when every active irrevocable or assignment interest is captured on the request

steps.title: Validate allocation percentages and per-stirpes wording in the admin system
sop: Total the primary allocations and total the contingent allocations separately
Confirm each total equals exactly 100 percent with no rounding shortfall
Compare the per-stirpes or per-capita wording requested against the contract language
Done when both totals and the distribution wording are confirmed or flagged
verify: Recompute both allocation totals from the form image rather than the keyed values
Pass when both totals equal 100 percent and the wording matches the contract

steps.title: Test trust and entity designations for existence and insurable-interest defects
sop: Confirm a trust designation carries trust name, trust date and named trustee
Confirm an entity designation carries the legal entity name and tax identification number
Assess whether the named party has an insurable interest consistent with the contract
Done when each trust or entity designation is cleared or flagged with the specific defect
verify: Compare the trust details on the request against the trust document image where one is on file
Pass when no trust or entity designation is cleared with a missing name, date or tax ID

steps.title: Record the compliance assessment and cited provision on the service request
sop: Write the outcome, permitted or blocked, into the service request notes
Cite the contract provision relied on and list any blocking interest found
Set the pend reason code where the designation cannot proceed as requested
Done when the service request carries a dated assessment note with the citation
verify: Reopen the service request and read the assessment note as saved
Pass when the note states the outcome, the citation and any pend reason code

generic.Defined scope/population: Beneficiary change requests received by mail, phone, agent or portal awaiting requestor authentication
generic.In-scope period: Requests received since the last authentication queue sweep
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authentication method, identifiers matched, verifier ID and authentication outcome all recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authenticated request count equals intake count for the same receipt window
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authentication stamp with date, method and verifier ID held on the service request
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed authentications logged with the reason and the callback or return-to-owner action taken
generic.Test population: Sample of authenticated beneficiary change requests across mail, phone and portal channels
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where fewer than two owner identifiers were matched before the request advanced
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected impersonation routed to the fraud queue and the request held pending investigation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: At least two identifiers matched and the signature agrees with the signature of record
generic.Evidence location: Service request authentication panel in the policy administration system and the CRM interaction record

steps.title: Log the incoming request and its channel in the CRM
sop: Create or open the CRM interaction for the beneficiary change request
Record the channel used: mail, telephone, agent submission or self-service portal
Attach the request image or portal submission reference to the interaction
Done when the interaction records the channel and links the source document
verify: Reopen the interaction and confirm the channel and the source link are present
Pass when every request in the queue has a channel and a linked source

steps.title: Match at least two owner identifiers against the policy administration system
sop: Pull the owner record and compare full name, date of birth and last four of the tax ID
Compare the policy number and the address of record given by the requestor
Record which identifiers matched and which failed
Done when at least two identifiers are confirmed matched or the request is marked failed
verify: Recheck one matched identifier directly against the owner panel
Pass when two or more identifiers are recorded as matched on the request

steps.title: Compare the form signature to the signature of record in the document repository
sop: Open the application image or the last signed servicing form for this owner
Compare the signature on the change form against that signature of record
Refer any material difference to a second reviewer before proceeding
Done when the signature is accepted or referred with the difference noted
verify: Confirm the comparison document ID is recorded on the request
Pass when the signature comparison outcome and the document ID are both recorded

steps.title: Apply the address-change hold check in the policy administration system
sop: Open the address history panel and read the date of the last mailing address change
Determine whether that change falls inside the 30 day fraud-hold window
Apply the address-change hold to the request where it does
Done when the hold is applied or the request is confirmed outside the window
verify: Recheck the address history date against the hold decision recorded
Pass when no request inside the 30 day window advanced without the hold

steps.title: Confirm multi-factor authentication for portal-submitted requests
sop: Open the portal session detail for the submission in the policy administration system
Confirm multi-factor authentication succeeded on that session
Confirm the portal user is the registered owner and not a delegate or agent
Done when the session is confirmed authenticated and owner-submitted, or the request is failed
verify: Compare the portal user identity against the owner of record
Pass when no portal request advanced from a delegate account or an unauthenticated session

steps.title: Stamp the authentication result and verifier ID on the service request
sop: Set the authentication status to passed or failed on the service request
Record the method used, the identifiers matched and the verifier ID with the date
Return failed requests to the owner in writing citing the authentication shortfall
Done when the request carries a complete dated authentication stamp
verify: Reopen the request and read the authentication panel as saved
Pass when no request advances to posting with status failed or not attempted

generic.Defined scope/population: Posted beneficiary changes requiring a written confirmation to the policyowner of record
generic.In-scope period: Beneficiary changes posted in the current business day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: New primary and contingent names, relationships, allocation splits and posting date on the letter
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmation letters generated equals beneficiary changes posted for the day
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated confirmation PDF imaged to the policy folder with the generation timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable or suppressed confirmations logged with the reason and the reissue action
generic.Test population: Sample of posted beneficiary changes across print and e-delivery elections
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a posted change has no confirmation correspondence record within one business day
generic.Exception handling path: Returned mail routed to address research and the confirmation reissued to the corrected address
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Letter addressed to the policyowner of record and shows the designation exactly as posted
generic.Evidence location: Policy document folder in OpenText Document Mgmt under the beneficiary-change document type

steps.title: Generate the beneficiary change confirmation letter in the policy administration system
sop: Open the posted beneficiary change transaction and launch the confirmation letter template
Populate the new primary and contingent names, relationships and allocation splits as posted
Include the posting effective date on the letter
Done when a draft confirmation exists showing the designation exactly as posted
verify: Compare each name and percentage on the draft against the beneficiary panel
Pass when every name, relationship and percentage on the letter matches the posted record

steps.title: Confirm the letter is addressed to the policyowner of record
sop: Check the addressee block resolves to the policyowner and not the new beneficiary
Check the mailing address equals the address of record on the admin system
Correct the addressee where the template resolved the wrong party
Done when the addressee and address both match the owner of record
verify: Compare the addressee block against the owner panel in the admin system
Pass when no confirmation is addressed to a party other than the owner of record

steps.title: Insert the review and how-to-correct instructions block
sop: Confirm the standard review your designation paragraph is present on the letter
Confirm the how-to-correct instructions and the servicing contact details are present
Add the block from the approved template where it is missing
Done when both required content blocks appear on the confirmation
verify: Read the issued letter and locate both required blocks
Pass when no confirmation is released without the review and correction instructions

steps.title: Route the confirmation to e-delivery or print per the owner election
sop: Read the paperless election flag on the policy administration system
Send to the e-delivery inbox where the election is active
Release to the print and mail stream the same business day otherwise
Done when the confirmation is queued on the channel matching the election
verify: Compare the delivery channel used against the current paperless election
Pass when the channel used matches the owner election on the policy

steps.title: Attach the generated PDF to the policy folder in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Export the issued confirmation PDF exactly as sent
Index it to the policy under the beneficiary-change document type
Record the policy number, transaction ID and send date on the index
Done when the PDF is retrievable from the policy folder by transaction ID
verify: Search the policy folder by the beneficiary-change transaction ID
Pass when the imaged confirmation returns and opens legibly

steps.title: Record the send date on the beneficiary change transaction
sop: Write the confirmation send date and channel back to the transaction record
Log any suppression or undeliverable outcome with its reason
Raise a reissue task where delivery failed
Done when every posted change carries a confirmation send date or a logged exception
verify: Run the posted-changes list and check for missing confirmation send dates
Pass when no posted beneficiary change lacks a send date or a logged exception

generic.Defined scope/population: Beneficiary change requests requiring spousal, irrevocable beneficiary or assignee consent before posting
generic.In-scope period: Requests in the consent determination queue for the current servicing day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State of issue, contract type, consent type required and consent document status all recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consent determinations recorded equals requests routed for consent review
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consent determination note and any imaged consent document with received date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing consents pended with the specific missing-consent reason code and owner notification
generic.Test population: Sample of requests across community property states, ERISA contracts and assigned policies
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a posted change on an irrevocable-beneficiary policy has no imaged consent
generic.Exception handling path: Absent consent pends the request and triggers a written consent request to the owner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every consent required by state and contract type is on file, signed and correctly dated
generic.Evidence location: Consent requirement panel in the policy administration system and consent images in OpenText

steps.title: Determine the state of issue and contract type in the policy administration system
sop: Open the policy header and read the state of issue and the product or contract type
Identify whether the contract is qualified or ERISA covered
Record both on the consent determination note
Done when the state of issue and contract type are recorded on the request
verify: Compare the recorded state and contract type against the policy header
Pass when both values are recorded and match the policy record

steps.title: Determine whether spousal or community-property consent is required
sop: Check the consent matrix entry for the state of issue and contract type
Decide whether spousal or community-property consent applies to this change
Record the determination and the rule relied on
Done when the spousal consent requirement is determined and recorded
verify: Re-read the matrix entry for the recorded state and contract type
Pass when the determination matches the matrix entry for that state

steps.title: Check the policy for an irrevocable beneficiary requiring written consent
sop: Open the beneficiary panel and identify any beneficiary flagged irrevocable
Where one exists, raise the requirement for that beneficiary's written consent
Block the request from being keyed until that consent is imaged
Done when any irrevocable beneficiary consent requirement is raised on the request
verify: Check the requirement list against the irrevocable flags on the beneficiary panel
Pass when every irrevocable beneficiary has a matching open or satisfied consent requirement

steps.title: Confirm assignee consent or subordination where an assignment is recorded
sop: Query the assignment register for any active collateral or absolute assignment
Locate the assignee consent or subordination document in OpenText Document Mgmt
Raise a requirement where no consent document is on file
Done when assignee consent is confirmed on file or raised as outstanding
verify: Open the imaged consent and confirm it names this policy and this change
Pass when every active assignment has a matching consent document or open requirement

steps.title: Validate the ERISA or qualified contract spousal waiver form
sop: Open the spousal waiver image for the qualified or ERISA covered contract
Confirm it is notarized or witnessed by a plan representative
Confirm the waiver date sits inside the required election window
Done when the waiver is accepted or rejected with the defect stated
verify: Recheck the notary seal, commission expiry and the waiver date
Pass when no qualified contract change is cleared on an unnotarized or out-of-window waiver

steps.title: Pend the request with the missing-consent reason code
sop: Set the pend status and the specific missing-consent reason code on the request
Issue the written consent request to the owner listing exactly what is outstanding
Diary the follow-up date for the outstanding consent
Done when every request with a missing consent is pended and the owner is notified
verify: Review the pended queue and read the reason code on each item
Pass when no request with an outstanding consent sits in a ready-to-post status

generic.Defined scope/population: Posted beneficiary changes requiring distribution of an updated document package to the owner
generic.In-scope period: Beneficiary changes posted and endorsed in the current distribution cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, endorsement effective date, revised beneficiary schedule and transaction ID present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packages distributed equals endorsed beneficiary changes released for the cycle
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Distributed package indexed with document type, version and distribution date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed or returned distributions logged with the reason and the reissue outcome
generic.Test population: Sample of distributed packages across e-delivery and print elections
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a superseded beneficiary schedule remains flagged active on the policy
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable packages route to address research and are reissued once corrected
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current schedule indexed under the beneficiary-change transaction ID with no active superseded version
generic.Evidence location: Policy document folder in OpenText Document Mgmt and the distribution log on the transaction

steps.title: Assemble the updated document package in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Collect the endorsement page, the revised beneficiary schedule and the confirmation letter
Confirm all three relate to the same beneficiary-change transaction
Assemble them into a single package for distribution
Done when the three-part package exists against the transaction
verify: Open the assembled package and confirm each component is present
Pass when the package contains the endorsement, schedule and confirmation letter

steps.title: Verify the endorsement page details against the policy record
sop: Check the policy number and effective date on the endorsement against the admin system
Check the beneficiary schedule on the endorsement equals the posted designation
Return the package for regeneration where any value differs
Done when the endorsement details are confirmed to match the posted record
verify: Compare the endorsement schedule line by line against the beneficiary panel
Pass when no endorsement is distributed with a policy number or schedule mismatch

steps.title: Route the package to e-delivery or print per the owner election
sop: Read the current paperless election on the policy administration system
Post to the e-delivery inbox or release to print and mail accordingly
Confirm the mailing address is not flagged undeliverable before print release
Done when the package is queued on the correct channel
verify: Compare the channel used against the paperless election on the policy
Pass when no package is mailed to an address flagged undeliverable

steps.title: Log the distribution date on the beneficiary-change transaction
sop: Write the distribution date and channel back to the transaction record
Record any bounce, return or suppression with its reason
Raise a reissue task where distribution failed
Done when every package has a distribution date or a logged failure
verify: List endorsed changes for the cycle and check for missing distribution dates
Pass when every endorsed change carries a distribution date or a logged exception

steps.title: Index the package to the policy folder with the transaction ID
sop: Index the package under document type, effective date and beneficiary-change transaction ID
Confirm the index values are keyed rather than left to default
Confirm the images are legible and complete
Done when the package is retrievable by transaction ID from the policy folder
verify: Search the policy folder by the transaction ID and open the result
Pass when the package returns on a transaction ID search and opens legibly

steps.title: Retire the prior beneficiary schedule version in the repository
sop: Locate any earlier beneficiary schedule still flagged active for the policy
Mark it superseded and set the current schedule as the active document
Retain the superseded version rather than deleting it
Done when exactly one beneficiary schedule is flagged active for the policy
verify: Filter the policy folder for active beneficiary schedules
Pass when only the current schedule is flagged active and prior versions are retained as superseded
